query: Worst headache of my life that started suddenly while lifting weights.
Sharp pain in the right lower belly for 6 hours with fever.
Throwing up blood and severe stomach pain.
Dizziness with slurred speech for the last hour.
Coughing up streaks of blood.

Back pain with numbness in both legs and trouble urinating.
Sore throat with drooling and trouble breathing.
Known diabetic with fruity breath and confusion.
Flank pain and fever with UTI symptoms.
Sudden vision loss in one eye this morning.
Repeated vomiting after falling off a bike and hitting my head.
I have dragon pox from Hogwarts.
I feel a little off but cannot describe any symptom clearly.
